description: Skills are the primary unit of reusable procedural specialization. This index exposes minimal metadata (always discoverable); full instructions load from each skill's SKILL.md only when selected. Each canonical skill records which legacy skill(s) it came from (source_provenance).

skills.name: adr-write
skills.description: Write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) — lightweight documents capturing a significant architectural decision, context, options, decision, and consequences.

skills.name: architecture-diagram
skills.description: Create standards-based C4/sequence/data-flow architecture diagrams as version-controlled text (Mermaid/PlantUML), paired with ADRs.

skills.name: api-design
skills.description: Design REST/GraphQL APIs as an OpenAPI 3.1 contract (endpoints, schemas, auth, errors, versioning) and derive developer documentation from the spec.

skills.name: tdd-execute
skills.description: Execute a test suite via the deterministic test.execute operation and report red/green results with actionable failures.

skills.name: test-authoring
skills.description: Author tests from requirements/specs — unit, integration, E2E, and BDD/Gherkin — with structured, traceable cases; run via test.execute.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Review code, architecture, and dependencies for security (OWASP/CWE/STRIDE) and audit secrets. Reasoning-only capability; it declares no deterministic operation.

skills.name: git-publication
skills.description: Branch, commit, PR, and merge discipline backed by the deterministic git operations (sanity, feature-start, feature-pr-gate, merge-gate).
source_provenance: (synthesized from legacy git operations, not a legacy skill)

skills.name: postoffice
skills.description: Consult and write the agent-to-agent postoffice — the operational-coordination channel. Advisory, never a gate; governance acts never travel it.

skills.name: ponyexpress
skills.description: Intake and trace Professor-originated instructions via the PonyExpress channel, correlated through delegation to results.
source_provenance: (synthesized; PonyExpress channel has no direct legacy skill)
